asset.name: MasterDetail
asset.description: The coordinated collection-and-detail layout preserving selection, scroll position, route state, and transition continuity, and drilling in rather than splitting on compact viewports.

requires.reason: Desktop adjacency and resizing are shared.
Drill-in versus adjacency is a behavioral breakpoint.

signatureMoment.description: Selecting a record on a compact viewport drills into detail and returning restores the list exactly where it was, including scroll position and selection, so a triage pass is never interrupted.
